raw_text: {"relevant_claims":["Under these assumptions, the lowest compliant price at a $0.15 fee is about 2.70%.","Pricing should be revisited once the interchange mix report arrives.","The requested price is 24.46% above the enterprise list price of 2.15% + $0.15, so no discount approval is needed."],"evidence_ids":["FACT-cost","FACT-volume","FACT-transactions","FACT-request","PRC-2026.2§1","PRC-2026.2§2","PRC-2026.2§3","PRC-2026.2§4","PRC-2026.2§5","PRC-2026.2§6","PRC-2026.2§7","PRC-2026.2§8"],"explanation":"No material claim is unsupported.
